programs.name: Computer Science BSc
programs.ib_offer: 38 points overall with 18 at Higher Level, including 7 at Higher Level in Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretations)
programs.ap_offer: US high school diploma with a GPA of at least 3.4 (the figure for A*AA courses) plus three additional qualifications from: SAT evidence-based reading and writing section 650+ or ACT 28+; AP Tests at 4 or above (more commonly 5); AP classes over two semesters in Grade 11 or 12; Honors classes in both semesters of Grade 12; dual enrolment/college courses; IB HL courses; A levels. Subject requirements must be met through AP Tests (or IB HL / A levels): any course asking for maths needs AP Calculus BC at grade 5.
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics (A* at A level; 7 at IB HL; AP Calculus BC at 5 for US applicants)
programs.toefl_note: English Profile E. TOEFL iBT taken up to 20 January 2026 (0-120 scale): 88 overall with R20 L19 S22 W22. TOEFL iBT taken from 21 January 2026 (1-6 scale): 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills.
programs.english_note: English Profile E (IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, 6.0 in all skills; or GCSE English Language grade C/4; or an alternative qualification listed in Profile E). PTE Academic 67 overall, 64 in all skills.
programs.notes: 2027 entry page. Contextual offer AAB including A in Mathematics, or IB 34 points with 17 at HL including 6 at HL Maths. Fee shown is the international fee for the first year (international fees rise annually). The GPA and test/AP rules are from the US applicants page: https://www.bristol.ac.uk/international/countries/usa.html . English profile: https://www.bristol.ac.uk/study/language-requirements/profile-e/ . Deadline: https://www.bristol.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/apply/international/ (equal consideration 13 January 2027, 6 pm UK; final international deadline 30 June).

programs.name: Economics BSc
programs.ib_offer: 38 points overall with 18 at Higher Level, including Mathematics with either 6 at Higher Level (Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretations) or 7 at Standard Level (Analysis and Approaches)
programs.ap_offer: US high school diploma with a GPA of at least 3.4 (the figure for A*AA courses) plus three additional qualifications from: SAT evidence-based reading and writing section 650+ or ACT 28+; AP Tests at 4 or above (more commonly 5); AP classes over two semesters in Grade 11 or 12; Honors classes in both semesters of Grade 12; dual enrolment/college courses; IB HL courses; A levels. Subject requirements must be met through AP Tests (or IB HL / A levels): any course asking for maths needs AP Calculus BC at grade 5.
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics (A level; IB HL 6 or SL Analysis and Approaches 7; AP Calculus BC at 5 for US applicants)
programs.toefl_note: English Profile G. TOEFL iBT taken up to 20 January 2026 (0-120 scale): 88 overall with R24 L22 S22 W22. TOEFL iBT taken from 21 January 2026 (1-6 scale): 4.5 overall with 5 in reading and listening and 4.5 in speaking and writing.
programs.english_note: English Profile G: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 7.0 in reading and listening and no score below 6.0 (so the highest component minimum is 7.0 in reading and listening). PTE Academic 67 overall, 71 in reading and listening, 64 in other skills.
programs.notes: 2027 entry page (BSc Economics, L100; there is also a BA Economics). Contextual offer AAB including Mathematics, or IB 34 points with 17 at HL. Fee shown is the international fee for the first year. The GPA and test/AP rules are from the US applicants page: https://www.bristol.ac.uk/international/countries/usa.html . English profile: https://www.bristol.ac.uk/study/language-requirements/profile-g/ . Deadline: https://www.bristol.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/apply/international/ (equal consideration 13 January 2027, 6 pm UK).

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering BEng
programs.a_level_offer: A*AA including A*A (in any order) in Mathematics and any one of Further Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science
programs.ib_offer: 38 points overall with 18 at Higher Level, including 7, 6 (in any order) at Higher Level in Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretations) and any one of Physics, Chemistry or Computer Science
programs.ap_offer: US high school diploma with a GPA of at least 3.4 (the figure for A*AA courses) plus three additional qualifications from: SAT evidence-based reading and writing section 650+ or ACT 28+; AP Tests at 4 or above (more commonly 5); AP classes over two semesters in Grade 11 or 12; Honors classes in both semesters of Grade 12; dual enrolment/college courses; IB HL courses; A levels. Subject requirements must be met through AP Tests (or IB HL / A levels): any course asking for maths needs AP Calculus BC at grade 5; for physics, AP Physics 1, AP Physics 2 or both AP Physics C tests are accepted, and can be used where a course asks for an additional maths/science subject.
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics plus one of Further Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science (A level); IB HL Mathematics plus one of Physics, Chemistry or Computer Science; AP Calculus BC at 5 for US applicants
programs.toefl_note: English Profile E. TOEFL iBT taken up to 20 January 2026 (0-120 scale): 88 overall with R20 L19 S22 W22. TOEFL iBT taken from 21 January 2026 (1-6 scale): 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills.
programs.english_note: English Profile E (IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, 6.0 in all skills; or GCSE English Language grade C/4; or an alternative qualification listed in Profile E). PTE Academic 67 overall, 64 in all skills.
programs.notes: 2027 entry page for the 3-year BEng (H305); Bristol also offers MEng Mechanical Engineering routes. Contextual offer AAB including AA (any order) in Mathematics and one of the listed subjects, or IB 34 points with 17 at HL including 6, 6 in Mathematics and one of Physics, Chemistry or Computer Science. In the event of many applications, preference may be given to applicants taking three of the listed subjects including Mathematics. Fee shown is the international fee for the first year. The GPA and test/AP rules are from the US applicants page: https://www.bristol.ac.uk/international/countries/usa.html . English profile: https://www.bristol.ac.uk/study/language-requirements/profile-e/ . Deadline: https://www.bristol.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/apply/international/ (equal consideration 13 January 2027, 6 pm UK).
